categories.title: Nintendo Gallery Picture
categories.info: Take a picture of this character or enemy with the Deluxe Picto Box to turn them into a collectible figure at the Nintendo Gallery near Forest Haven. Best location is shown.

categories.title: Treasure Chart
categories.info: Treasure Charts mark treasure locations with an X, but aren't required to retrieve the treasure. However, the target locations they point at differ between playthroughs.

categories.title: Treasure Chest
categories.info: Distinct from Rupee Chests, these Treasure Chests contain collectibles, such as Butterfly Necklaces or Golden Feathers.

categories.title: Rupee
categories.info:
Rupees are colored gems that are used as currency. The color of the Rupee determines its value:


* Green Rupee: 1
* Blue Rupee: 5
* Yellow Rupee: 10
* Red Rupee: 20
* Purple Rupee: 50
* Orange Rupee: 100
* Silver Rupee: 200

categories.title: Rupee Chest
categories.info: Sunken chest locations identified by Treasure Charts vary. Always refer to the Treasure Charts accessible from the Sea Chart menu to see the exact location for your playthrough.
